Counter Logic Gaming (often abbreviated as CLG) was an American esports organization mostly known for their League of Legends lineup. The organization ceased operations as an independent brand upon being acquired by NRG on April 6, 2023. [1]

  • January 16th - Counter Logic Gaming sign former squad of mouseSpaz consisting of reltuC, FNS, hazed, tarik, and ptr. [2]
